title: SpotDraft Claude Connector: Query Contracts in Claude
markdown:
Can Claude see all of our contracts?

No. Claude only sees contracts the signed-in user has permission to access in SpotDraft. Existing roles and access controls apply exactly as they do inside the product.

Is the SpotDraft connector in the Claude directory read-only?

Yes. Nothing in SpotDraft can be changed through the directory connector. Write actions require a custom connector with write mode enabled.

Does Claude read the actual contract text or just the metadata?

Both. Structured Contract Metadata such as dates, values and parties are exposed as-is. Full extracted text is also available for clause-level analysis, as long as text extraction has completed on the contract. Scanned PDFs without OCR may not return text.

Which Claude plans support the connector?

Connectors are available on paid Claude plans. On Team and Enterprise plans an admin adds the connector once for the whole organisation. Check the current Claude plan details for your account before rolling it out.

Do I need API keys?

No. The directory connector uses OAuth. You sign in with your normal SpotDraft credentials and nothing needs to be stored or rotated.

Which region does my data go through?

SpotDraft hosts regional servers for India, the United States, Europe and the Middle East. Your connector uses the server that matches your workspace. If you are unsure which region you are on, ask your CSM.

Can I use the SpotDraft MCP Server with tools other than Claude?

Yes. The server works with any MCP-compatible client, including Cursor, Cline, ChatGPT, Notion and Microsoft Copilot Studio.

What happens if I enable write mode and something goes wrong?

Write tools only run when a user explicitly asks Claude to take an action. They never run on their own. You can switch write mode off at any time by removing the parameter from the server URL.

# Hello Claude, meet your contracts: SpotDraft is now in the Claude connector directory

[Get a personalized demo](https://www.spotdraft.com/request-a-demo?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=hero-cta&utm_campaign=claude-connector)

![Adityanarayan Ravishankar](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6ae35639147f6f8366512333_aditya.avif)

By

![Hello Claude, meet your contracts: SpotDraft is now in the Claude connector directory](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6aec767c67aef696c62d4dc3_6ae35ec6df87ffbb766eee0d_Frame%25202147226434.png)

### TL;DR

- SpotDraft is now listed in the [Claude connector directory](https://claude.ai/directory/spotdraft). Any SpotDraft customer on Claude can connect it from Settings and start asking questions about their contracts in plain English.
- The directory connector is read-only. Claude can search your contract library, read full contract text, extract contract metadata, check approvals and activity logs, browse templates and list legal intakes.
- Access mirrors your SpotDraft permissions. Claude only sees what the signed-in user can see. OAuth handles sign-in, so there are no API keys to manage.
- Teams that need write actions (uploading versions, creating approvals, adding comments, creating intakes or tasks) can add SpotDraft as a custom connector with write mode enabled.
- Typical uses: bulk clause review for legal and renewal and payment-obligation tracking for finance.

Software has been organized around apps since forever. If you wanted to understand a customer, you opened your CRM. If you wanted to understand your financials, you opened your ERP. And if you wanted to understand your contracts, you opened your CLM.

Each app comes with its own unique interface, quirks, foibles and learning curves. But the winds of change have gathered force rapidly. AI is, in what is a somewhat violent turn of phrase, rendering software **_headless_**.

So what does that really mean? To extend the anatomical analogy: your software retains the arms and legs, but now, its body can take direction from almost any “head” out there.

Head = Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other applications of their ilk.

At [SpotDraft](https://www.spotdraft.com/), we have long believed in the inevitability of a headless future and have actively been at the vanguard. The vision is taking shape: SpotDraft is now [officially listed in Claude's connector directory](https://claude.ai/directory/spotdraft) and featured in its latest launch of legal artifacts.

## What happens when Claude meets SpotDraft?

SpotDraft extends Claude's reach beyond individual contracts, enabling it to **_query thousands of agreements_** and surface intelligence across your portfolio **.**

Claude can also **_initiate actions directly within SpotDraft_**, while operating **_within your organization's rules_** and guardrails, whether these are approval paths, access controls, delegation rules or something else.

### Some things you can do today using claude:

**1\. Portfolio-wide contract analysis**: Compare key terms across thousands of agreements and identify patterns, outliers, and deviations from standard positions.

![Portfolio-wide contract analysis: SpotDraft through Claude](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6ae360ad9e86a2665bc95344_img-Portfolio-wide%20contract%20analysis.avif)

**2\. Contract risk identification**: Surface agreements with unusual liability caps, indemnity provisions, termination rights, or other risk-bearing clauses.

**3\. Task and review coordination**: Assign tasks, add comments, and coordinate follow-up on contract-related work.

**4\. Contract workflow progression**: Initiate supported actions to move contracts through established lifecycle processes.

**5\. Playbook deviation handling**: Identify deviations from standard contract positions and initiate the appropriate review or approval process.

![Playbook deviation handling: SpotDraft through Claude](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6ae36110a32edca8cec1efc7_img-Playbook%20deviation%20handling.avif)

**6\. Approval status visibility**: Identify contracts awaiting approval, outstanding decisions, and pending approvers.

![Approval status visibility: SpotDraft through Claude](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6ae3613a17385820043da890_img-Approval%20status%20visibility.png)

**7\. Contract review prioritization**: Surface agreements that require closer legal scrutiny based on unusual terms, deviations, or potential risk.

![Contract review prioritization: SpotDraft through Claude](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6ae3615ec1cbf1b50932a577_img-Contract%20review%20prioritization.png)

**8\. Legal intake and request management**: Create legal requests from Claude and track their progress through SpotDraft.

![Data privacy review with Legal: SpotDraft through Claude](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6ae37ce41aa177b9ce6967f9_img-Legal%20intake%20and%20request%20management-2.avif)

![Legal intake and request management: SpotDraft through Claude](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6ae3619d2a5d24e63d9553d6_img-Legal%20intake%20and%20request%20management-1.png)

**9\. Initiate contract approvals**: Start approval workflows for contracts requiring review or authorization.

![Initiate contract approvals: SpotDraft through Claude](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a746048684529/6ae361e172f5bd1c7f450bfe_img-Initiate%20contract%20approvals.avif)

All actions operate within SpotDraft's configured permissions, approval paths, delegation rules, and workflow controls.

## Heads may change. The body endures.

The headless future isn't about making the CLM irrelevant. It's about extending its intelligence and capabilities beyond its own interface, without compromising the controls that make it dependable. Claude is one step in that direction. And we're just getting started.

‍

P.S: We also have a fully functional, fully loveable OpenAI connector that is identical in every way to Claude’s but more on that later…
